regions.today: Any lingering patchy mist will clear away early this morning with lots of crisp dry autumnal sunshine following. Fine, dry and settle conditions will continue right through the afternoon and evening with light winds too but it will feel a little chiller at times with highs of just 10 to 13 degrees.
regions.tonight: A dry and clear night with light winds. Starting to feel a little cooler though with lows of 2 to 4 degrees allowing some mist or fog patches to form overnight as well.
regions.tomorrow: Plenty of sunshine and dry weather throughout with light winds and highs of 10 to 13 degrees.
